surface exchange

Expose starting belts to saturated precursor in DMSO

Combine the starting amine-ligated belts with excess saturated Cd(PTC)2 in DMSO at room temperature. The absolute belt charge, solution volume and numerical room temperature are unknown. Missing fields for this phase: absolute amounts, precursor solution volume, defined reaction room temperature.
